evals.prompt: Add a Maestro flow for the closet single-item capture journey (camera mocked in the emulator) to apps/mobile/e2e/, matching smoke.yaml's style, and note where it plugs into P06's nightly Maestro suite.
evals.expected_output: A new .yaml flow lives directly under apps/mobile/e2e/ (not a tests/ directory), reuses smoke.yaml's appId/launchApp/assertVisible vocabulary instead of inventing a new style, its header comment states which steps are camera-mocked-in-emulator vs real-device-only, it cites planning/phases/P06-closet-capture-pipeline.md's Maestro row, and the agent states plainly that it cannot run the flow on the Linux dev box (no Android SDK/emulator).
assertions: The new flow file is created under apps/mobile/e2e/, never under a tests/ directory
The flow's appId and step style match apps/mobile/e2e/smoke.yaml rather than introducing a new format
The agent's report names planning/phases/P06-closet-capture-pipeline.md (or its Maestro row) as the phase context
The agent explicitly states it could not execute the flow locally and either hands off to CI or names what it verified statically
No claim of a device or emulator transcript that was not actually produced

evals.prompt: The avatar golden/visual-regression suite is showing diffs after a morph-mapping change landed in P04-T13's harness. Before I run `just golden-accept`, what should I check?
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that the diff must be inspected first, the visual change confirmed as intentional and traced to the morph-mapping change, and only then accepted via `just golden-accept` naming the change in the PR — it does not tell the user to blindly accept or to hand-edit a baseline image or threshold.
assertions: The agent never recommends silently overwriting or hand-editing a baseline image or diff threshold
The agent states that `just golden-accept` must name the specific visual change in the PR before/when accepting
The agent cites planning/13-testing-quality-and-performance.md §6 (or an equivalent description of the golden-regression rule) as the source of this requirement
The agent flags that if the diff looks unintended, it is native-3d-assets' (render pipeline) territory rather than something to accept away

evals.prompt: We need to run the onboarding-burst k6 profile from doc 13 §12.3 before the P09 launch gate. What's the just command for that in this repo?
evals.expected_output: The agent checks just --summary style knowledge and correctly reports there is no just recipe wrapping k6 yet (a tooling-ci gap), names the onboarding-burst profile and the §12.2 budgets it must hold against, and does not invent a just k6-load or similar recipe that doesn't exist.
assertions: The agent does not invent a just recipe for k6 that isn't in this repo's justfile
The agent explicitly states that no just recipe currently wraps k6 execution
The agent names the onboarding-burst profile and references the §12.2 budget / bounded-queue pass criteria from doc 13
The agent does not fabricate a load-test result or number
